title: Graceful Warm-Swap Choreographer for VPC Data-Plane Runtime Upgrades
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Implement a deterministic, reversible orchestration layer (the 'Warm-Swap Choreographer') for private VPC data-plane runtime upgrades. Goal: perform runtime code and kernel updates across tenant slices with zero observable downtime and deterministic rollback when health gates fail. The choreographer coordinates IaC-driven capacity changes, tenant slice quiesce, cache snapshot/forward, lightweight priming, synthetic probes, and live rollback triggers tied to telemetry and request-level error budgets.
acceptance_criteria: Upgrade completes across a 24-tenant staging cluster with no client-visible 5xx increase > 0.1% and p95 latency regression < 10%
Automated rollback triggers and runbook execute within 90s of breach and restore previous runtime version without dropping active KV state more than one epoch
Terraform plan/apply integration runs in canary mode and outputs deterministic change set; failures abort rollout with explanatory diagnostics
Observability dashboards surface slice-level health, priming progress, and cache-forward status; alerts map to rollback playbook links
plan_steps: Phase 0 - Preflight: run terraform plan with IaC guard rails; validate module version compatibility and node-label drift
Phase 1 - Provision staging slice: instantiate a warm canary slice (1-2 pods) with new runtime AMI/container and sidecar compatibility checks
Phase 2 - Snapshot & Drain Prep: snapshot in-memory KV prefixes for canary tenants and mark primary slice as draining candidates (no immediate eviction)
Phase 3 - Cache Forward: apply snapshot-to-canary forwarder; perform snapshot replay into canary runtime, validate KV checksums
Phase 4 - Lightweight Priming: run live synthetic traffic at low qps to populate attention/KV caches and measure cold vs warmed latency
Phase 5 - Health Gate: evaluate SLOs (5xx rate, p95/p99 latency, token throughput, error budget burn) and custom probe success ratio over sliding 5-min window
Phase 6 - Incremental Step-up: shift 10% of tenant slices to new runtime (Terraform apply to re-route) while continuing cache-forward for consistency

Phase 7 - Full Cutover or Rollback: if gates pass, continue stepping until 100% cutover; if gates fail, trigger deterministic rollback path to prior runtime and reconcile KV state back to original hosts
Phase 8 - Post-mortem & Metrics: emit rollout timeline, anomalies, and final state snapshot to the rollout audit log
rollback_playbook: Auto-detect: monitor health gates; on breach mark rollout as 'failed' and set throttles to 0% for further step-ups
Freeze new-slice ingress: immediately remove new runtime slices from routing layer and divert traffic to previous version
KV State Reconciliation: if snapshot-forward completed, run reverse-forward to copy any accepted deltas back to original slice; verify checksums
Fast failover: if reverse-forward cannot complete safely within 3 minutes, spawn temporary passthrough proxy to maintain session affinity while rollback completes
Alert & Triage: create incident, tag on-call, attach rollout audit and links to failing probes; if necessary, escalate to SRE rotation
Post-rollback Validation: run end-to-end synthetic tests and validate per-tenant token continuity reports before marking rollback 'complete'
notes: Design trade-off: we favor deterministic snapshot-forward over live concurrent writes to avoid split-brain KV semantics; this adds a priming window but simplifies rollback semantics.
Decision: use a two-tier canary (micro + staged) rather than single canary to catch both cold-cache and steady-state regressions.
Open question: whether to include a short 'graceful handoff' period where both runtimes accept reads for 30s to reduce client retries — needs API team input.
Terraform detail: plan output must include slice routing changes as explicit resources so operator can approve and abort easily from the console.
Performance note: observed priming QPS target for 8K token sequences is ~120 RPS per slice to reach acceptable warm cache hit ratio in 3 minutes.
